name: Zuplo Developer API
description: Manage Zuplo accounts, projects, deployments, API Key Service resources, metering, and analytics. Authenticate with a scoped Zuplo account API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header. Create account API keys in [Account Settings](https://portal.zuplo.com/+/account/settings/api-keys). Zuplo account API keys are distinct from the consumer credentials issued through the Zuplo API Key Service. Create a separate account API key for each agent or automation, and restrict it to only the projects, environments, project permissions, and account permissions that task requires.
